instructions.name: ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched forward. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return. 

It primarily works the rectus abdominis muscle and the obliques.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
You will get better results if you do it slowly.
Relax your neck.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
It's not right to use your arms to propel your body upwards.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when raising, and inhale when lowering.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
You shouldn't feel your neck is sore.
It's a good workout for your abs.

instructions.name: LEG RAISES
instructions.introduce:
Lie down on your back, and put your hands beneath your hips for support. 

Then lift your legs up until they form a right angle with the floor. 

Slowly bring your legs back down and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Raise up your legs faster and put them down slower.
Your back should always be flat on the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
Don't pull your shoulders up off the floor.
Exhale when lifting your legs, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too hard, put a little bend in your knees.
You shouldn't feel any pressure in your chest and shoulder area.
This exercise targets your lower abdominals.

instructions.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER
instructions.introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

instructions.name: INCHWORMS
instructions.introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. \n\nBend your body and walk your hands in front of you as far as you can, then walk your hands back. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Try to keep your legs straight.
Tighten your core.
Don't lift or lower your hips when your body is stretched out.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise targets the shoulders, core and hamstrings.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.

instructions.name: CROSSOVER CRUNCH
instructions.introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your ears. \n\nRaise and twist your torso so your right elbow moves to meet your left knee. Repeat with the other side.

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Raise your upper body to bring your elbows towards your knees.
Exhale as you slowly raise your upper body, and inhale as you return to the start position.
Your neck shouldn't feel sore.
This exercise targets the obliques and rectus abdominis.
This exercise can tone your abs and treat lower back pain.

instructions.name: FLUTTER KICKS
instructions.introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
Make sure your back is flat against the floor.
Tighten your core.
Breathe regularly.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise targets the abs and legs.
This exercise can increase core strength and improve your endurance.

instructions.name: HEEL TOUCH
instructions.introduce: Lie on the ground with your legs bent and your arms by your sides. \n\nSlightly lift your upper body off the floor and make your hands alternately reach your heels.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in a natural position.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Engage your core.
Exhale when touching your heels and inhale when going back.
It's a great exercise for all of your abdominal muscles.

instructions.name: SIDE ARM RAISE
instructions.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Raise your arms to the sides at shoulder height, then put them down. 

Repeat the exercise. Keep your arms straight during the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your arms straight during the exercise.
Pull your shoulders back.
Do not arch your back.
Exhale as you raise your arms, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise targets your deltoids and upper back.

instructions.name: ADDUCTOR STRETCH IN STANDING
instructions.introduce:
Stand with your feet wide distance apart and your hands rested on your hips. 

Then bend your left leg and lean your body to the left side. 

Hold the position for a few seconds, then return and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Shift your weight away from the stretched leg until you feel the stretch in your inner thigh.
Squeeze the butt of the stretching side to increase the stretch.
Your feet should point straight forward.
Please don't rotate your feet out.
Exhale as you lower your body, and keep breathing normally as you hold the stretch.
You should feel stretch in the inner thigh of the stretching leg.
This exercise can stretch your inner thighs.

instructions.name: ARM CIRCLES COUNTERCLOCKWISE
instructions.introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Move your arms counterclockwise in circles fast.

Try to do it as fast as you can.

It's a great exercise for the deltoid muscle.

tips.text: Keep your arms straight.
Your arms should go from small circles to big circles.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
This exercise targets your deltoids.
This exercise really helps loosen up your shoulders.
This is a great exercise to build arm muscle endurance.

instructions.name: CAT COW POSE
instructions.introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, curve your back upward and let your head come down. Repeat the exercise.

Do it slowly with each step of this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

instructions.name: CHEST STRETCH
instructions.introduce:
Find a doorway, take a lunge position in the doorway with your arms on the doorframe and your elbows a little lower than your shoulders, then slowly bring your chest forward. 

Hold this position for 30-40 seconds. Then slowly come out of it, bring your arms down and do a couple of shoulder rolls.

Don’t pull your head forward, and keep your neck relaxed.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a doorway.
Please keep you neck relaxed.
Please don’t pull your lower back or head forward.
You should feel stretch in your chest and shoulders.
You shouldn\'t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your chest and shoulders.

instructions.name: CHILD'S POSE
instructions.introduce:
Start with your knees and hands on the floor. Put your hands a little forward, widen your knees and put your toes together. 

Take a breath, then exhale and sit back. Try to make your butt touch your heels. Relax your elbows, make your forehead touch the floor and try to lower your chest close to the floor. Hold this position.

Keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back. Make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears during the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Breathe regularly.

instructions.name: JUMPING JACKS
instructions.introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

instructions.name: SHOULDER STRETCH
instructions.introduce: Place one arm across your body, parallel to the ground, then use the other arm to pull the parallel arm toward your chest. \n\nHold for a while, switch arms and repeat the exercise. Keep the inside arm straight during the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

instructions.name: SWIMMER AND SUPERMAN
instructions.introduce: Lie on your stomach with your arms extended straight overhead. Alternately lift your opposite arm and leg.

tips.text: You should do it on a mat.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too easy, raise both your legs and arms at the same time.
This exercise will engage your abs.
This exercise will strengthen your butt and lower back.

instructions.name: WALL PUSH-UPS
instructions.introduce: Stand in front of a wall one big step away from it. Then put your hands out straight towards the wall and lean against it. Lift your heels.\n\nSlowly bend your elbows and press your upper body towards the wall. Push back and repeat the exercise. Remember to keep your body straight.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your abs.
Inhale when bending your arms, and exhale when stretching them out.
To make it harder, perform a traditional push-up on the floor.
This exercise primarily targets your chest and arms.

instructions.name: SIDE LEG RAISE LEFT
instructions.introduce: Lie on your right side with your forearm supporting your upper body and your left hand on the ground in front of you. \n\nKeep both legs together. Lift your legs lightly and hold for one second, then return to the start position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your legs are straight.
Please do this slowly to avoid hurting your hip.
Please keep your elbow at a 90 degree angle.
Please keep your feet together.
Please hold your legs for one second when lifting them.
Please don\'t rotate your hips when lifting your legs.
Exhale when lifting your legs and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your obliques burning, even shivering.
It\'s a great workout for your obliques.
This exercise can help burn off your love handles.

instructions.name: SIDE LEG RAISE RIGHT
instructions.introduce: Lie on your left side with your forearm supporting your upper body and your right hand on the ground in front of you. \n\nKeep both legs together. Lift your legs lightly and hold for one second, then return to the start position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your legs are straight.
Please do this slowly to avoid hurting your hip.
Please keep your elbow at a 90 degree angle.
Please keep your feet together.
Please hold your legs for one second when lifting them.
Please don\'t rotate your hips when lifting your legs.
Exhale when lifting your legs and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your obliques burning, even shivering.
It\'s a great workout for your obliques.
This exercise can help burn off your love handles.

instructions.name: RECLINED OBLIQUE TWIST
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and your elbows directly under your shoulders.

 Lift your left leg up at a 45 degree angle while reaching your right arm over to your left side.

 Then slowly go back to the starting position. Repeat several times, and then switch to the other side.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do this slowly to get better results.
Please keep your legs straight.
If you feel the exercise is too hard, you can put your legs on the floor.
If you feel the exercise is too easy, you can lift both legs.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your obliques, abs and thighs.

instructions.name: SIDE BRIDGES LEFT
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your right side. Put your right elbow directly under your shoulders and put your left hand on your waist. Place your left leg on your right leg.

Raise your hips upward, hold for 2-4 seconds, then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your abs tight.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
You should feel your obliques burning.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your bottom knee on the floor.
It’s a great exercise for your obliques.

instructions.name: TRICEPS DIPS
instructions.introduce: For the start position, sit on the chair. Then move your hip off the chair with your hands holding the edge of the chair. \n\nSlowly bend and stretch your arms to make your body go up and down. This is a great exercise for the triceps.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair or bench.
Pull your shoulders back.
Open your chest.
Don't let your shoulders go forward.
Inhale when bending your arms and exhale when stretching them.
If you feel it's too easy, enlarge the distance between your feet and the chair.
You should feel your triceps engage.
This exercise really works on your arm muscles.

instructions.name: SIDE BRIDGES RIGHT
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your left side. Put your left elbow directly under your shoulders and put your right hand on your waist. Place your right leg on your left leg.

Raise your hips upward, hold for 2-4 seconds, then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your abs tight.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
You should feel your obliques burning.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your bottom knee on the floor.
It’s a great exercise for your obliques.

instructions.name: SIDE-LYING FLOOR STRETCH LEFT
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your right side with your right knee slightly bent in front of you and your left leg stretched behind the right leg.

Straighten your left arm over your head and gently pull on your left wrist to stretch the left side of your body.

Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your waist.
Breathe naturally.

instructions.name: SIDE-LYING FLOOR STRETCH RIGHT
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your left side with your left knee slightly bent in front of you and your right leg stretched behind the left leg.

Straighten your right arm over your head and gently pull on your right wrist to stretch the right side of your body.

Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your waist.
Breathe naturally.

instructions.name: HYPEREXTENSION
instructions.introduce:
Lie down on your stomach with your toes touching the floor, and your chin on your hand.

Raise your chest up as high as possible off the floor. Hold this position for a few seconds and then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Raise your chest as high as possible off the floor.
Please do it slowly to get a better result.
Please hold at the top for 2 seconds.
Please keep your toes on the floor throughout the exercise.
Breathe out when lifting your chest, and breathe in when lowering it.
It’s an effective exercise that works your lower back.

instructions.name: RECLINED RHOMBOID SQUEEZES
instructions.introduce:
Sit with your knees bent. Slightly lean your upper body back.

Stretch your arms in front of you, then pull your elbows back to make your elbows at a 90 degree angle and squeeze your shoulder blades.

Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your abs tight.
Please squeeze your shoulder blades when pulling your elbows back.
Too easy? You can sightly lift your feet or hold dumbbells in your hands.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders, back and abs.

instructions.name: RHOMBOID PULLS
instructions.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Raise your arms parallel to the ground, and bend your elbows. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please squeeze your shoulder blades when pulling your elbows back.
Please keep your triceps contracted.
Exhale when pulling your elbows back, and inhale when going back to the start position.
Too easy? You can hold dumbbells in your hands.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders and upper back muscles.

instructions.name: PRONE TRICEPS PUSH UPS
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your hands underneath your shoulders and your elbows bent.

Slightly raise your chest up, and then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a little stretch in your abdominal muscles.
Please squeeze your triceps to push your chest up off the floor.
Please put your hands directly under your shoulders.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
Please don’t relax on the mat during the exercise.
Please don’t lift your hips up off the floor.
This exercise not only can strengthen your triceps, but also can relieve your lower back pain.

instructions.name: TRICEPS KICKBACKS
instructions.introduce:
Lean forward, bend your knees and your elbows.

Extend your arms behind you and squeeze your triceps. Please make your arms parallel to the ground when extending them.

Go back to the start position, and repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your neck and spine in line.
Please fully extend your arms when kicking them back.
Please squeeze your triceps when kicking your arms back.
Please don\'t move your upper arm.
Exhale when extending your arms, and inhale when bringing them back.
If you feel it’s too easy, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
It’s an excellent exercise for the triceps muscles.

instructions.name: PIKE PUSH UPS
instructions.introduce: Start with your hands and feet on the floor. Put your hands shoulder width apart. Bend your body, and lift your hips up in an upside down \'V\' shape.\n\nBend your elbows, and bring your head close to the floor. Push your body back, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please put a towel on the floor.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your legs straight and back flat.
Please drop your head between your arms.
Exhale as you push your body back, and inhale as you lower it.
It’s a good exercise for building strength and endurance.
This exercise targets your triceps and shoulders.

instructions.name: HOVER PUSH UP
instructions.introduce: Start in a push-up position. Lower yourself; shift your body to the left and then to the right.\n\nPush your body up and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your body straight.
Please go down until your elbows are at a 90 degree angle.
It’s a good exercise for all your upper body muscles.

instructions.name: SUPINE PUSH UP
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor and your arms bent on two sides.

Push your chest up as far as you can, and then slowly go back to the start position.

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your neck relaxed.
Please lift your shoulders up as high as you can off the mat.
Please do it slowly to get a better result.
To get more of a challenge, put your elbows on two stable chairs.
This exercise tones your upper back, especially your rhomboids.

instructions.name: REVERSE SNOW ANGELS
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your arms at your sides.

Lift your arms up and extend them over your head to touch your thumbs. Then slowly bring them back.

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get a better result.
Please don’t let your arms touch the ground during the exercise.
To get more of a challenge, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
To get more of a challenge, you can lift your feet up off the floor.
This exercise can help build your endurance.
This exercise strengthens the muscles of your scapular region.

instructions.name: ARM SCISSORS
instructions.introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.

Stretch your arms in front of you at shoulder height with one arm overlap the other in the shape of the letter “X”, and then spread them apart.

Switch arms, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please always keep your arms at shoulder height.
If it\'s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.

instructions.name: FLOOR Y RAISES
instructions.introduce: Lie face down on the floor with your arms fully extended and your thumbs pointing up, your body should be in the shape of the letter “Y”.\n\nRaise your arms off the ground as far as you can and pause them at the top for 2 seconds. Slowly go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your arms straight during the exercise.
Tighten your abdominals.
Pause your arms at the top, then slowly drop them down.
Exhale when lifting your arms, and inhale when dropping them down.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders and upper back.

instructions.name: V-UP
instructions.introduce: Lie on your back with your arms and legs extended and your legs squeezed together.\n\nRaise your upper body and legs, use your arms to touch your toes, then go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your legs straight and your feet together.
Exhale when raising your upper body and legs, and inhale when putting them down.
If you feel it is too easy, you can hold weights in your hands.
If you feel it is too hard, touch your knees instead of your toes.
It works on your abs and back.

instructions.name: HIP HINGE
instructions.introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.

Sit your hips back and bend your upper body while keeping your upper body straight, then slowly go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

Inhale as you bend down, and exhale as you come up.

tips.text: Please engage your core.
Please squeeze your glutes as you stand up.
You should feel stretching in your hamstrings as you bend down.
Push your hips back as you bend down.
Please keep your weight on your heels.
Inhale as you bend down, and exhale as you come up.

instructions.name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Exhale, lift your right leg up and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Keep your other arm extended to the side on the floor. 

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Breathe regularly.

instructions.name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Exhale, lift your left leg up and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Keep your other arm extended to the side on the floor.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Breathe regularly.

instructions.name: COBRA STRETCH
instructions.introduce: Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders. \n\nThen push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. Hold this position for seconds.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe slowly while holding yourself up.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

instructions.name: SIT-UPS
instructions.introduce:
Lie on your back with your hands behind your ears. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor and slowly up to the sitting position. Don't tug your neck when you get up. 

Slowly go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

If your spine hurts, please change to another workout.

tips.text: You need to do it on a mat.
Please relax your neck.
Please do this workout slowly.
Please don't use your explosive strength.
Put your hands behind your ears, don't interlock your fingers.
Don't tug your neck to get up.
If your spine hurts, please change to another workout.
Exhale as you come up, and inhale as you lower.
To make it harder, you can extend your legs and put your arms over head.

instructions.name: PUSH-UPS
instructions.introduce:
Lay prone on the ground with arms supporting your body. 

Keep your body straight while raising and lowering your body with your arms. 

This exercise works the chest, shoulders, triceps, back and legs.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your wrists directly under your shoulders.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, elevate your feet on a bench.
To make it more challenging, clap your hands when pushing up.
Too hard for you? You can elevate your hands on a bench.
If you feel it's too hard, do it with your knees on the floor.
To make it easier, do it with your hands against a wall.
This exercise really works on your chest, abs and triceps.
This exercise helps build your strength and endurance.
Adjust your performance if you feel strain in your shoulders.

instructions.name: CALF STRETCH LEFT
instructions.introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your right foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your left leg is fully extended and you can feel your left calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

instructions.name: CALF STRETCH RIGHT
instructions.introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your left foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your right leg is fully extended and you can feel your right calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

instructions.name: TRICEPS STRETCH LEFT
instructions.introduce: Put your left hand on your back, use your right hand to grab your left elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your left shoulder down when pulling your left elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

instructions.name: TRICEPS STRETCH RIGHT
instructions.introduce: Put your right hand on your back, use your left hand to grab your right elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your right shoulder down when pulling your right elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

instructions.name: SQUATS
instructions.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms stretched forward, then lower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. 

Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes. Return to the start position and do the next rep. 

This works the thighs, hips buttocks, quads, hamstrings and lower body.

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If it's too easy for you, go lower for a deep squat.
If you feel it's too hard, widen your feet to get more balance.
This works on all the muscles of your lower body.
This exercise will help you get good balance.

instructions.name: SINGLE LEG CALF HOP LEFT
instructions.introduce: Stand straight with your right leg lifted. Then hop up and down on your left foot.

tips.text: Please land on the ball of your foot.
Please try not to let your heel touch the floor.
If it\'s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
It\'s a great exercise to strengthen your calf muscles.

instructions.name: SINGLE LEG CALF HOP RIGHT
instructions.introduce: Stand straight with your left leg lifted. Then hop up and down on your right foot.

tips.text: Please land on the ball of your foot.
Please try not to let your heel touch the floor.
If it\'s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
It\'s a great exercise to strengthen your calf muscles.

instructions.name: LEANING STRETCHER RAISES
instructions.introduce: Stand a big step away from the wall, put your hands on the wall and lean on it. \n\nLift your heels as high as you can and then lower them down. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please squeeze your calf muscles when raising your heels up.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
Please raise your heels up as high as you can.
Please fully stretch your calves when lowering your heels down.

instructions.name: KNEE PLANK

instructions.name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT

Please tighten your core.

instructions.name: BUTT BRIDGE

instructions.name: DONKEY KICKS LEFT
instructions.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

instructions.name: SPIDERMAN PLANK

instructions.name: FIRE HYDRANT RIGHT

Lie face down on a bench, place your butt on the edge of the bench and hold on to the sides.

Stand with your hands on your hips and feet a little wider than shoulder width apart.

instructions.name: BENT KNEE SIDE HIP RAISES RIGHT

Lie on your left side with your elbow down the floor and your knees bent. Place your right hand on your hips.

instructions.name: STANDING OBLIQUE CRUNCHES RIGHT

instructions.name: CHEST PRESS PULSE

If your arms are sore, don't worry, it's working.

instructions.name: DIAGONAL PLANK

Start in the straight arm plank position.

Lift your right arm and left leg until they are parallel with the ground.
